name: sts crane operation
description: Operating ship-to-shore (quay) cranes to load and discharge vessels.

name: rtg crane operation
description: Operating rubber-tyred gantry cranes to stack containers in the yard.

name: reach stacker operation
description: Operating reach stackers within their load charts.

name: container lashing
description: Securing deck containers with lashing rods, turnbuckles and twistlocks.

name: crane signalling and rigging
description: Signalling crane operators and rigging loads safely.

name: dangerous goods handling
description: Handling, segregating and responding to dangerous goods under the IMDG Code.

name: vessel stowage planning
description: Planning container positions on board (bay plans) for stability and port sequence.

name: berth planning
description: Allocating berths and time windows to vessels.

name: yard planning
description: Planning container positions in the yard to minimize rehandles.

name: terminal operating system
description: Using the TOS to plan, dispatch and track container moves.

name: container inspection
description: Checking container condition, damage and seals at handover.

name: gate transaction processing
description: Processing truck arrivals, pickups and drop-offs at the terminal gate.

name: shipping documentation
description: Bills of lading, manifests, VGM and customs holds.

name: reefer container monitoring
description: Monitoring refrigerated containers and responding to alarms.

name: port crane maintenance
description: Preventive and corrective maintenance of port cranes.

name: mooring operations
description: Securing and releasing vessels at the berth.

name: port radio communication
description: Clear radio communication, including VHF marine procedures.

name: port facility security
description: Security measures under the ISPS Code.

name: terminal safety procedures
description: Terminal HSE rules: traffic separation, PPE, stop work, near misses.
